Lojban News channel ('''lo lojbo nuzba tcana''') is a project of notifying people around the world of the news related to Lojban.

In order to create it the following parts have to <u>be integrated more tightly</u>:
* One of the most important parts of this planned system is this wiki.
** [[Special:RecentChanges|Recent Changes]] page shows the most recent edits to this wiki.
** [https://twitter.com/uitki A Twitter page] and a [https://www.facebook.com/LojbanHQ Facebook page] also shows the recent changes.
* People post questions and news to the main discussion group in [https://www.facebook.com/groups/lojban/ Facebook], [http://reddit.com/r/lojban/ Reddit], [https://plus.google.com/communities/105661163321603750740 Google+] or ask questions to [https://twitter.com/LojbanHQ Lojban LLG account] in Twitter.
* [[Nuzba|A separate wiki page]] is planned to show the most relevant news in different languages.
* [[Lojban timeline|Lojban timeline]] is to be merged with the news channel.
